page.overview:
Who is Neilos?

Neilos is a river-god of what is now called the Nile in Aigyptos (modern day Egypt) in North Africa.

To the Greeks, other than Neilos aka Nile, the only other north African river known personified (occupied by a river god) was the Khremetes of western Libya.
